text: The single criterion that matters most is the effectiveness of onboarding for achieving team success and integrating new members efficiently. Among the given options, **option C) the one intensive bootcamp week** stands out as the best choice because it provides comprehensive training and support in a concentrated timeframe, ensuring all new hires have foundational knowledge and skills ready for immediate integration into the team's workflow. This approach minimizes confusion and maximizes productivity during the initial ramp-up period.
